articles.title: My Cat
articles.content: I have a cat. It is white. It is small. It has big eyes. I love my cat. My cat loves me too.
articles.translation: 我有一只猫。它是白色的。它很小。它有大大的眼睛。我爱我的猫。我的猫也爱我。

questions.q: Is the cat big or small?

articles.title: My Family
articles.content: I have a family. This is my dad. This is my mom. This is my baby brother. We are happy. I love my family.
articles.translation: 我有一个家。这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。这是我的小弟弟。我们很开心。我爱我的家。

articles.title: I Can Do Many Things
articles.content: I am five. I can run. I can jump. I can sing. I can dance. I can read books. I cannot fly. But I can dream!
articles.translation: 我五岁。我能跑。我能跳。我会唱歌。我会跳舞。我会读书。我不能飞。但我能做梦！

questions.q: What can the writer NOT do?
What CAN the writer still do though they can't fly?

articles.title: Colors I Like
articles.content: I like red. I like apples. I like blue. I like the sky. I like green. I like trees. Colors are fun!
articles.translation: 我喜欢红色。我喜欢苹果。我喜欢蓝色。我喜欢天空。我喜欢绿色。我喜欢树。颜色真有趣！

questions.q: What color does the writer like for apples?
What is blue in the story?
How does the writer feel about colors?

articles.title: My Toys
articles.content: I have many toys. I have a red ball. I have a yellow car. I have a pink doll. I love my toys. I play every day.
articles.translation: 我有很多玩具。我有一个红球。我有一辆黄色的车。我有一个粉娃娃。我爱我的玩具。我每天都玩。

questions.q: How often does the writer play?

articles.title: My Dog
articles.content: I have a dog. It is brown. It is big. It can run fast. It can jump high. I love my dog. My dog loves me.
articles.translation: 我有一只狗。它是棕色的。它很大。它能跑得快。它能跳得高。我爱我的狗。我的狗也爱我。

questions.q: Is the dog big or small?

articles.title: Apples Are Red
articles.content: Apples are red. Bananas are yellow. Pears are green. Grapes are purple. I like fruit. Fruit is sweet. I eat fruit every day.
articles.translation: 苹果是红色的。香蕉是黄色的。梨是绿色的。葡萄是紫色的。我喜欢水果。水果是甜的。我每天都吃水果。

articles.title: I Like Animals
articles.content: I like animals. I like cats. They are cute. I like pandas. They eat bamboo. I like birds. They can fly. I like fish. They can swim.
articles.translation: 我喜欢动物。我喜欢猫。它们很可爱。我喜欢熊猫。它们吃竹子。我喜欢鸟。它们会飞。我喜欢鱼。它们会游泳。

articles.title: A Day at School
articles.content: I go to school. I see my teacher. I see my friends. We read books. We sing songs. We play games. School is fun. I like my school.
articles.translation: 我去学校。我看见我的老师。我看见我的朋友。我们读书。我们唱歌。我们玩游戏。学校很有趣。我喜欢我的学校。

questions.q: Who does I see at school?
What do they do at school?
How does the writer feel about school?

articles.title: My Mom
articles.content: This is my mom. She is kind. She is nice. She can sing. She can cook. She loves me. I love my mom. Mom is the best.
articles.translation: 这是我妈妈。她很善良。她人很好。她会唱歌。她会做饭。她爱我。我爱我的妈妈。妈妈是最棒的。

articles.title: Numbers I Know
articles.content: I can count. One, two, three. I have three pens. Four, five, six. I have six books. Seven, eight, nine, ten. I can count to ten!
articles.translation: 我会数数。一，二，三。我有三支笔。四，五，六。我有六本书。七，八，九，十。我能数到十！

questions.q: How many pens does the writer have?
How many books does the writer have?
How high can the writer count?

articles.title: I Can Run
articles.content: I can run. I run fast. I run with my dog. We run in the park. The park is big. We are happy. I love to run.
articles.translation: 我会跑。我跑得快。我和我的狗一起跑。我们在公园里跑。公园很大。我们很开心。我喜欢跑步。

articles.title: A Sunny Day
articles.content: Today is a sunny day. The sun is bright. The sky is blue. I see white clouds. I am happy. I go to the park. I play with my friends.
articles.translation: 今天是晴天。太阳很亮。天空是蓝的。我看见白云。我很开心。我去公园。我和朋友们玩。

articles.title: My Bag
articles.content: I have a new bag. It is blue. It is big. I have a book in my bag. I have a pen. I have a ruler. I love my bag.
articles.translation: 我有一个新书包。它是蓝色的。它很大。我书包里有一本书。我有一支笔。我有一把尺子。我爱我的书包。

questions.q: Is the bag new or old?
What is NOT in the bag?

articles.title: Big and Small
articles.content: An elephant is big. A mouse is small. A house is big. A box is small. My dad is big. My baby brother is small. I am in the middle.
articles.translation: 大象很大。老鼠很小。房子很大。盒子很小。我爸爸很高大。我的小弟弟很小。我在中间。
